# PerchTV 0.1.25

Captions and Voice Guide on Samsung televisions, tidied after testing on a set.

## WHAT CHANGED

- On Samsung televisions, a film's own captions now show cleanly, without stray characters at the end of each line.
- On Samsung televisions, Voice Guide always has something to read when you return to the waiting screen, after closing the list of phones or stopping a film.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- OK leaves live TV playing, up to eight phones, and the list of paired phones.
